references.text: In Matthew 18:3-6, Jesus speaks about the importance of being like children to enter the kingdom of heaven, which resonates with his call in Matthew 19:14 not to hinder children from coming to him.
Luke 18:16-17 contains a parallel event where Jesus also emphasizes that the kingdom of heaven belongs to those who are like children, directly related to the event in Matthew 19:14.
Mark 10:14-16 gives a parallel account where Jesus urges the disciples to let the children come to him, and he blesses them, reflecting the event and message in Matthew 19:14.
